answer:
Done — I turned “Spanish verbs” into a phone-friendly flashcard app on the note’s App side.

It now:
- Flips Spanish ↔ English
- Lets you mark cards as “I know it” or “Again”
- Remembers known cards
- Shows unknown cards first
- Includes progress and a reset option

I also checked the app for mobile layout, dark mode, contrast, and note updates; it passed.
